summary: Two rules were added to the drawing — an edge label keeps clear of every line but its own, and arrows arriving at one box land on a single line or far enough apart to read as two — and an eleventh diagram joins the sample sets to hold them: one large ER, three times the area of anything else and the only thing here with arrows close enough together to crowd each other. A full check therefore has more to do than the recorded numbers did, and is slower for that reason rather than because anything got worse. Per diagram nothing moved.
why: The label search gained one term per candidate and route repair gained a pass that groups arrowheads by where they arrive; both are arithmetic over geometry already parsed, so neither adds a d2 compile or a browser start. Every count that grew is the eleventh diagram's own — 10 more layout candidates and 3 more browser starts, of which its single note is 8 and 1.
